liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko-Iko** (1 review): The performance of Iko-Iko was described as pretty cool by the listener [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-06-26.aud.Taggart.Naks.116647.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 114 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1986-06-26.aud.sirmick.92713.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 113 min [2]
- **gd86-06-26.sony-ecm.miller.25616.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 117 min; rated 2.3/5 by 20 [3]. Said about its sound: Audio quality was poor generally, but acceptable for listeners positioned on the floor; Sound echoed significantly off the bubble roof, making it the worst venue heard; Sound quality remained poor even for listeners seated in the front rows [7][8][12][13][14][16]
- **gd1986-06-26.139268.partial.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 11 songs; 80 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- A shy friend aggressively rushed the field, foreshadowing later injurious crowd behavior [9]
- Bob Dylan performed well, while the Grateful Dead set was considered anticlimactic by fans [10]
- The band transitioned directly from Mexicali Blues into Estimated Prophet without a break [12]
- Crowd members jumped on top of each other while rushing toward the stage floor [13]
- The reviewer passed out during the Dylan set after drinking beer and missing sleep [14]
- The audience spun and danced while the band performed a drum solo with fire [15]
- The band struggled to hear themselves due to the dome's design for loud sounds [16]
- Sound towers facing the stage created a wash effect, complicating the audio experience [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-06-26.aud.Taggart.Naks.116647.flac16**: taped by Danny Taggart; transferred by Greg Holtz; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-100 mics w/ CP-1 Caps > Sony D-6 (Maxell MX-90 Cassette Tapes); [1]
- **gd1986-06-26.aud.sirmick.92713.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by SIRMick; source: Unknown Audience Source [2]. Also: Tape flips after Tennessee Jed and in Drums were crossfaded, with some audio missing; The first few notes of Gimme Some Lovin' are clipped in this recording [2]
- **gd86-06-26.sony-ecm.miller.25616.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info: Sony ECM-939 -> Cassette Master -> CDTransfer Info: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> SHNTransfered and Edited By Charlie Miller [3]
- **gd1986-06-26.139268.partial.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Tascam Deck/TDK SA-X90) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome - June 26, 1986](https://www.dead.net/show/june-26-1986) [19]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome - June 26, 1986](https://www.dead.net/show/june-26-1986) [20]
